note: Generated by scripts/sync-releases.mjs from each release's "What is new" section; a release whose body has no lines in the format "- **Title**: sentence" keeps the entry below.

lines.title: Update and grant
lines.text: When an update asks for a new permission, one Confirm installs it and grants it.

lines.title: Protected permissions stay off
lines.text: Publishing, spending and other protected permissions wait for an administrator on the agent's card.

lines.title: Missed permissions on Home
lines.text: If an earlier update left a permission out, Home asks once, with Allow and Not now.

lines.title: Several agents, one Allow
lines.text: When one press updates several agents of a package, Home names each of them.

lines.title: Nothing new at night
lines.text: Automatic updates never give an agent a new permission; that version waits for your Allow.

lines.title: Each product decides who reviews
lines.text: A product's rules say which AI companies may review its code and which must judge it.

lines.title: Reviews name the real AI
lines.text: A review's first line names the AI that did the review.

lines.title: The coder's company never reviews
lines.text: A review by the AI company that wrote the code does not run; Home offers another model.

lines.title: Box warnings on Home
lines.text: When a product's rules change or a lane must use another AI company, Home says so at the top.

lines.title: Your exact version
lines.text: Updates shows the exact version under the update's name, and the day it was installed.

lines.title: Go back names the day
lines.text: The button names the update you return to by its day, for example 25 October.

lines.title: What is new on Updates
lines.text: The Updates screen shows the first lines of what an update brings.

lines.title: Help on every Settings page
lines.text: Help for this page opens the part of the manual that explains it.

lines.title: The safety copy and your clicks
lines.text: What you start while a safety copy runs waits about 2 minutes, then runs.

lines.title: Hand-offs per copy
lines.text: An agent's page lists each copy of another agent by name, each with its own Allow and Remove.

lines.title: Teams take work through their lead
lines.text: To give work to a team such as Bob, an agent hands it to the team's lead.

lines.title: Product rules from every organisation
lines.text: A product's rules are read even when its repositories belong to another GitHub organisation.

lines.title: Updates and safety copies
lines.text: One Settings page keeps the box up to date and safe, with Update now and the nightly safety copy.

lines.title: One Update now on Home
lines.text: When an update is ready, Home shows it under Needs you, with Update now.

lines.title: Agents update with the box
lines.text: An agent's new version installs with the box; one that asks for more waits for your Allow on Home.

lines.title: Advanced as cards
lines.text: Advanced opens with one card per topic, each saying in one line how it stands.

lines.title: Settings in the left menu
lines.text: Settings' pages unfold in the left menu, and every entry is a link you can bookmark.

lines.title: Chat remembers for the company
lines.text: What you write in Chat is kept for colleagues and agents; untick one box to keep it to yourself.

lines.title: The memory learns by rules
lines.text: Facts from mail, the web or files wait for a person; each Monday Home lists what the company learned.

lines.title: Mail and calendars in your account
lines.text: Add a mailbox by typing its address; the box finds the way to connect it.

lines.title: The AI and costs
lines.text: See per agent what its runs cost and how many your ChatGPT plan carried.

lines.title: People and access
lines.text: Removing a person stops their sign-in at once; their private data can be restored for 30 days.

lines.title: New AI models from OpenRouter
lines.text: New models such as Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6.1 Sol appear in the lists without an update.
